dorsal_wing_plumage_topography.flight_feather_edge_geometry: High-contrast white margins are visible on the inner folded flight feathers, appearing as sharp boundaries against the neutral gray plumage.

crown_and_nape_macro_patterns.crown_to_mantle_demarcation: A distinct color transition is visible between the rufous-brown crown and the gray nape.

other_distinctive_markers: Prominent white patch on the lower back/rump and four pairs of high-contrast white transverse bars on the dark tail feathers.
